 By
 Golf Channel Staff , 
 By
 Golf Channel Staff 
     Published November 19, 2026 05:34 PM 
 Twitter 
 Email
 The CME Group Tour Championship continues Nov. 20 with the second round from Tiburon Golf Club as the LPGA Tour wraps up its season.
 The winner of the finale will walk away with $4 million from the tournament featuring the top 60 players.
 Jeeno Thitikul, A Lim Kim and Karis Davidson co-lead the tournament after shooting 7-under 65 during the opening round.
 Round 2 from Naples, Florida will be live on Golf Channel and Golf Channel mobile beginning at 2PM EST. on Friday, Nov. 20.
